references.text: Pagiel son of Ocran is again mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Asher during the camp setup.
Pagiel son of Ocran brings his offering as the leader of the tribe of Asher at the dedication of the altar.
Pagiel son of Ocran leads the tribal army of Asher when the people break camp from Sinai.
The tribe of Asher descends from Asher, Jacob's son with Zilpah, Leah's maidservant.
Asher is mentioned among Jacob's sons born to Zilpah.
